note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts the conduit size (2-1/2") and conductor count (3#4/0) for Symbol 150, whereas Set A misses the conduit size and incorrectly claims a ground conductor for 150. Both sets struggle with the garbled text layer for Symbols 31-34, resulting in similar symbol-mapping errors there, but Set B is more accurate on the primary feeder definitions.
